# C-Point HRIS & Workforce Portal

> Enterprise Human Resource Information System & Biometric Workforce Management Portal

## Overview
C-Point HRIS delivers workforce management, biometric attendance verification, and Philippine statutory payroll compliance.

## System Modules
- Biometric verification and contactless facial recognition timekeeping
- Automated Philippine weekly and semi-monthly statutory payroll processing (SSS, PhilHealth, Pag-IBIG, BIR Tax)
- Comprehensive audit logging and role-based access control (RBAC)
